summary: Smith & Nephew plc files Form 6-K disclosing that Cevian Capital II GP Limited crossed the 11% ownership threshold (11.013663% voting rights, 94,062,095 shares) on May 11, 2026. Cevian, a known activist investor, increased its stake from a previous 10.094356% position, signaling continued pressure on the medical device company. The filing does not include board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms. As a UK issuer (ISIN GB0009223206), the TR-1 notification maps to SEC beneficial ownership reports. The activist's growing stake suggests potential campaigns for operational changes, strategic review, or board representation. Watch for Cevian's public demands and Smith & Nephew's response.
